subject.title: feature request: `chat.history` should support a visible-only filter so `limit` can count conversation messages instead of transcript rows

question: Should `chat.history` gain a general additive conversation projection, and what cursor, total-count, and mixed-content semantics should that projection guarantee?
rationale: The implementation is bounded, but the request changes a public Gateway RPC contract used by multiple clients; source inspection cannot choose permanent compatibility and projection semantics safely.

options.title: Add typed conversation projection
options.body: Preserve current defaults and add an opt-in projection with raw-sequence cursors and limits counted after display projection.

options.title: Add a boolean visible-only mode
options.body: Implement the proposed boolean narrowly, accepting a less extensible contract and defining its totals and mixed-content behavior now.

options.title: Keep raw pagination only
options.body: Require clients to page raw transcript records until they accumulate enough visible messages, retaining current transfer and UX costs.

recommendation.title: Add typed conversation projection
recommendation.body: Preserve current defaults and add an opt-in projection with raw-sequence cursors and limits counted after display projection.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision affects the public Gateway chat contract and companion-client direction, and steipete has the strongest adjacent merged-history and issue-routing signal.
